description: This PHP file implements a web interface for managing port triggering settings in a network gateway device. It includes code to display the current port trigger configurations, enable or disable port triggering, and handle user actions such as adding, editing, and deleting port triggering rules. The file combines PHP, HTML, JavaScript, and embedded dynamic content to interact with the device's configuration or status.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values for specified device objects and their attributes.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a given device object.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves string configuration values from device parameters.
